overview: SpaceX reported Q3 2026 results, and Musk said $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is 'no longer impossible.' On the AI side, Aleksander Madry is returning to OpenAI to work on safety, OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio, and steipete reported big speedups from agent-driven rewrites. Much of the remaining feed was election and politics content, which we skipped.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - After SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings call, Musk says $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is 'no longer impossible'
Sam Altman - Aleksander Madry returns to OpenAI to work on safety and security challenges as AI approaches superintelligence
Joe Lonsdale - 8VC says portfolio company Orchestra Bio is joining OpenAI, adding a biology team to the lab
steipete - An agent loop moved OpenClaw's web frontend from Lit to Solid 2.0 in about 600 PRs over roughly two weeks
steipete - VoidZero's tsrs, a Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, was a drop-in swap and made OpenClaw around 5x faster
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase published a blog post on preparing Bitcoin for a post-quantum world with industry partners
Sundar Pichai - On the Big Technology Podcast, Pichai discusses recursive self-improvement, world models and DeepMind compute vs. Cloud profits
burrytracker - Michael Burry reportedly warns stocks sit on a 'supervolcano' and predicts decades of flat returns rather than a crash
